excluded_amounts.reason: Not counted here: the same dollars are counted once on cpr:ca7394abd0f80:4525 (overlap group crim-nisource-2020). One fine in case 1:20-cr-10066. The U.S. Attorney's release of 23 Jun 2020 (oversight.gov copy, read 2026-10-11) says Bay State Gas Company, d/b/a Columbia Gas of Massachusetts, was ordered 'to pay a criminal fine of $53,030,116'. NiSource's deferred prosecution agreement (justice.gov/usao-ma/page/file/1252061/dl, read 2026-10-11) sets no fine of its own: it requires NiSource to forfeit 'any profit or gain' from a sale of the business, an amount the agreement does not state. The registry lists the fine on the deferred-prosecution-agreement record ($53,030,116) and on the plea record ($53,030,125, nine dollars more than the court's figure). The row whose amount equals the court's figure is counted; the other is not.
